dsh.config.profile: DSH profile to start and install the bridge into (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`). Defaults to `web`; custom profiles must provide the web UI. Names may contain ASCII letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens, cannot start with a hyphen, and cannot be `.` or `..`.
dsh.config.launchPreference: Which `dsh` installation to prefer: `auto` (npm first, then DSH Desktop), `npm`, or `desktop`. If the preferred installation is missing, the other one is used automatically and the log records which source was actually used.
dsh.config.desktopCommandPath: Absolute path of the DSH Desktop command (usually `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\runtime\\cli\\bin\\dsh.cmd`). Leave empty to detect the default location automatically.
dsh.config.host: Service host. Only loopback values (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`) are allowed; invalid values fall back to the default.
dsh.config.port: Expected port for the DSH web service (used for both detection and startup).
dsh.config.autoStart: Automatically start `dsh web` when the service is not running.
dsh.config.stopOnExit: Stop the plugin-started service when the last VS Code window closes.
dsh.config.extraArgs: Extra arguments appended when the plugin starts `dsh web` (e.g. `--trusted-host`).
dsh.config.bridgeEnabled: Enable the DSH page bridge (external links and file jumps between the panel and DSH).
dsh.config.workspaceRootIndex: Which workspace root to use as the working directory for the auto-started `dsh web` (0-based; falls back to the first root when out of range).
dsh.config.bridgeSilenceWarning: Suppress bridge warnings (e.g. when a DSH page is open outside the panel).
dsh.config.executablePath: Absolute path to the dsh executable (dsh.cmd on Windows). Empty = look up on PATH.
dsh.config.openInBrowser: Open the DSH page in the default browser after the service starts (when off, `--no-open` is passed to `dsh web`).
dsh.config.remoteEnabled: Enable remote scenarios (SSH Remote / WSL / Dev Containers / Codespaces): run dsh on the remote host and open the panel through a VS Code tunnel. Off by default; when off, remote windows show a guide instead of starting a remote service. Requires `dsh` installed on the remote and a window reload after enabling.
dsh.config.imageFallback: When the active model does not support image input, automatically send attached images as file-path references instead of failing (files are cached in the session working directory and removed when the conversation ends).
dsh.walkthrough.title: Get Started with DSH
dsh.walkthrough.description: Use the DeepSeek Harness web UI right inside VS Code.
dsh.walkthrough.step.title: Open the DSH panel
dsh.walkthrough.step.description: Click the DSH icon in the Activity Bar or the Secondary Side Bar, or run [DSH: Open Panel](command:dsh.openPanel). The panel starts (or reuses) the dsh web service and embeds the DSH page in the sidebar.
dsh.cmd.copyLogs.title: DSH: Copy Logs
dsh.config.startTimeoutMs: How long to wait for `dsh web` to become ready, in milliseconds (default 45000). Cold start time depends on machine speed and the number of DSH plugins; raise this if the log says the service was not ready in time while it actually did start.
dsh.config.env: Extra environment variables injected into the DSH child process (key/value pairs, values must be strings); merged with the parent environment instead of replacing it. Typical use: on networks that require a proxy, set `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy` so Node's native fetch honours HTTP(S)_PROXY.
dsh.config.useEnvProxy: Append `--use-env-proxy` to the DSH child process's `NODE_OPTIONS` (your existing NODE_OPTIONS options are kept). Useful when the model API must be reached through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy.
dsh.config.panelZoom: Zoom the embedded `dsh web` page up or down — useful when the text is too large (or too small) in the sidebar. Pick 50%–150% from the dropdown (5% steps); for finer control, write any value between 0.5 and 1.5 directly in `settings.json`. 100% is the default. The page still fills the panel exactly, with no scrollbars, and clicks stay accurate.
